# FQHESphereLLLStatesProduct

Module: **FQHE** · directory: `FQHE/src/FQHEOnSphere` · binary: `FQHE/src/Programs/FQHEOnSphere/FQHESphereLLLStatesProduct`

Manual: [FQHESphereLLLStatesProduct (from the DiagHam wiki)](../manuals/FQHESphereLLLStatesProduct.md)

```text
FQHESphereLLLStatesProduct, version 0.01

Usage: FQHESphereLLLStatesProduct [options] 

Options:

system options:
    --states : names of the vector files obtained using exact diagonalization (multiple arguments)
    --haldane : use Haldane basis instead of the usual n-body basis
    --reference-file : use a file as the definition of the reference state

parallelization options:
    -S, --SMP : enable SMP mode
    --processors : number of processors to use in SMP mode (default value = 2)
    --smp-profil : enable SMP profiling, the name of the log file  has to be passed as argument

misc options:
    -h, --help : display this help

output options:
    -o, --bin-output : output the Jack polynomial decomposition into a binary file
    -t, --txt-output : output the Jack polynomial decomposition into a text file
    --normalize : the output vector will be normalize on the factory

global options:
    --append-cmdline : append command line to file
```
